name: hcportal_confirmAuthentication
description: Confirms a portal login request. Called by the portal (browser) — authenticated as the portal service account via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @qrCodeData as the callerParamString — while it waits for the mobile app to approve a login, either by scanning an on-screen QR code (@isQrFlow = 1, 5-minute TTL) or by the same-device app-login flow (@isQrFlow = 0, code in the URL, 90-second TTL). If a matching, unconsumed, in-TTL HC.WebPortalAuthenticationRequests row exists, the SP reuses the offered @newDeviceId only when that HC.Device row already belongs to the hasher logging in (2026-09-19: never hand one hasher another hasher's device); otherwise it provisions a new HC.Device row (IsMobile = 0) with a fresh shared secret. It returns the hasher's profile with the device credentials obfuscated as iconDataBase64 / colorPaletteIndex, then marks the request consumed (single use). No matching request returns silently with no rowset.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: the service account's device ID for authenticating this portal polling call. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: newDeviceId
parameters.description: The device id the browser offers (the one it already holds) so its HC.Device row can be reused. NULL is replaced with NEWID(). Replaced with a fresh NEWID() when the existing row belongs to a different hasher (or has no owner).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @qrCodeData as the paramString.

parameters.name: qrCodeData
parameters.description: The QR code payload to match against pending auth requests. Must be non-NULL and at least 10 characters (LEN check). Matched case-insensitively with TRIM(LOWER()). Also used as the paramString for auth token validation.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(250); column HC.WebPortalAuthenticationRequests.scanData is NVARCHAR(100). Harmless for matching (a longer value simply matches nothing).

parameters.name: deviceInfo
parameters.description: JSON device info for the browser session. Stored in HC.Device.DeviceData when provisioning a new device.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(4000); column HC.Device.DeviceData is NVARCHAR(MAX). Device info over 4000 characters is truncated silently.

parameters.name: isQrFlow
parameters.description: Selects the auth-request TTL: 1 = QR-scan flow (5 min, user needs time to scan an on-screen code), 0/default = same-device app-login flow (90 s, code rides in the URL so the replay window is kept tight). Server-decided so the caller cannot widen the app-login window.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, NULL or short (<10 chars) @qrCodeData, or a runtime error (CATCH returns ERROR_MESSAGE()). Short-circuits on first error.

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned when a matching WebPortalAuthenticationRequests record is found. Contains user profile and obfuscated device credentials. If no matching auth request exists, no rowset is returned at all (silent empty return — not an error).

columns.name: deviceId
columns.description: The provisioned device ID (@newDeviceId). Use this as the deviceId for all subsequent HC6 portal SP calls.

columns.name: publicHasherId
columns.description: TRANSITIONAL: The authenticated user's public hasher ID (from HC.Hasher). Retained for HC5 backward compatibility during migration. Remove once all portal SPs are on HC6.

columns.name: scanData
columns.description: The matched QR code scan data from HC.WebPortalAuthenticationRequests

columns.name: firstName
columns.description: User's first name. COALESCE to empty string.

columns.name: lastName
columns.description: User's last name. COALESCE to empty string.

columns.name: hashName
columns.description: User's hash name. COALESCE to empty string.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: User's display name (from HC.Hasher.DisplayName). COALESCE to empty string.

columns.name: photo
columns.description: User's photo URL. COALESCE to empty string.

columns.name: iconDataBase64
columns.description: OBFUSCATED: contains the device shared secret (75-char base64 string). Used by the portal for subsequent token generation.

columns.name: colorPaletteIndex
columns.description: OBFUSCATED: contains the time window in seconds (30–45) for token validity.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Device (id, UserId, DeviceSecret, TimeWindow, DeviceData, IsMobile = 0) when no reusable device row owned by the logging-in hasher exists. Wrapped in a transaction.
UPDATE HC.WebPortalAuthenticationRequests SET Removed = 1 WHERE scanData matches @qrCodeData (case/space-insensitive) — consumes the request so the code cannot be replayed.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 193-196: the CATCH rolls back and returns ERROR_MESSAGE() with no HC.ErrorLog row (the header says logging moved to the API shim), so a failed login confirmation leaves no server record.

codeSmells.issue: Consume is not atomic with the match
codeSmells.detail: The request is matched at lines 81-109 and consumed by a separate UPDATE at line 188, outside any transaction and without UPDLOCK. Two concurrent polls carrying the same code can both pass the check and both receive device credentials.
Lines 82, 107, 183 and 190 compare trim(lower(scanData)) = trim(lower(@qrCodeData)), which cannot use an index on scanData.
